registry_server.description: CREATE SOMETHING governed Active Jobs DB MCP wrapper over RapidAPI with D1 and Braintrust telemetry

dify_studio_steps: Create an HTTP MCP server card with server ID active-jobs.
Transcribe every discovered tool into config/dify/inventory.json with risk classification.
Run pnpm dify:inventory:generate and pnpm dify:coverage:generate.
notes: The Dify MCP server card has been created with server ID active-jobs.
The Active Jobs Dify app is tracked in config/dify/agents/registry.json.
This intake artifact is not the Dify agent registry.
Keep secret values in Infisical only; this artifact stores references, not values.
The app API key lives at prod:/dify/active-jobs-agent:DIFY_ACTIVE_JOBS_AGENT_API_KEY.
